summary: The table presents various configurations of transformer models, comparing their architectural parameters and performance metrics. It includes different setups labeled as base, (A), (B), (C), (D), and (E), with variations in parameters such as the number of layers (N), model dimension (d_model), feed-forward dimension (d_ff), number of attention heads (h), key and value dimensions (d_k, d_v), dropout rate (P_drop), and label smoothing (ε_ls). The performance is evaluated using perplexity (PPL) and BLEU scores on development data, with the number of training steps and parameter counts also provided. Notably, the 'big' model with positional embedding instead of sinusoids achieves the lowest perplexity of 4.33 and the highest BLEU score of 26.4, indicating superior performance.
